items.caption: An oracle-script form of 月 retains an enclosing crescent shape with an interior mark, consistent with its use as a pictograph of the moon.
items.alt: Black glyph with a long central stroke and curved outer stroke forming a crescent-like shape.
items.selection_reason: The visible form supports the documented half-moon pictographic explanation; its identification as a Shang oracle-script form is linked to a specific Sinica record.

items.caption: This seal-script form of 月 has a rounded outline, an interior stroke, and a curved lower extension.
items.alt: Black seal-style glyph with an oval outline, a short interior stroke, a cross-stroke, and a long curved tail.
items.selection_reason: It provides a useful comparison with the oracle-script form and is identified as a modern reconstruction of the Shuowen seal-script tradition.

limitations.text: These are modern redrawings, not photographs of ancient inscriptions. The oracle-script image is attributed to a specific Sinica record, but the available evidence does not establish the precise date of that inscription or the first attestation of 月.
